svg.title: backplane
svg.text: XB1: socket for B1 (PORTS A); key plug in contact 27 (blue dot)
XB2: socket for B2 (PORTS B + METERS); key plug in contact 28 (green dot)
XB3: socket for B3 (CORE); key plug in contact 29 (yellow dot)
XB4: socket for B4 (POWER); key plug in contact 30 (red dot)
XJ1: charger I2C pins (lead to EVM J8)
R7: charger sense 100 ohm, lying on the front, junction to a lone pad
R8: gauge sense 100 ohm, lying on the front (on a slant), junction to line 23

Backplane: BusBoard PAD3U padboard cut 31 x 38 holes, seen from the lid (glands down: the front, component side; line 0 at the left wall); a pad per hole, no strips: the bus wires on the copper side join them
Line: what its bus wire carries
16: spare bus line (for the charger interrupt)
black outline: card socket (generic female strip, every one cut to 1x30, lines 1-30)
small square: a pin in a hole
white square: a socket contact on an isolated pad (its card pin is spare or card-local: no bus wire)
black square K: the socket's key plug (a cut-off male pin in that contact, flush; its pad soldered to nothing else)
coloured line: bare bus wire on the copper side, ringed where soldered
purple ring: a lead soldered on the copper side
dashed: the mux, behind on foam
